summary: Fortinet FortiEndpoint Protect Plus: antivirus, EDR, DLP, sandbox, ZTNA and VPN in one agent with a cloud console.
value: Attacks are stopped before they run, and anything that gets through is visible in the event record and can be removed.
Confidential data does not quietly leave the computers.
Application access and VPN come from the same agent.
simple: A single Fortinet agent for computers, laptops, smartphones and tablets that combines FortiClient, FortiEDR and FortiDLP, with one cloud console and one license (cloud management only). Every edition includes zero trust access to applications (ZTNA) with continuous device posture checks, VPN, SaaS application control (CASB), vulnerability scanning on computers with remediation help, FortiGuard web and video filtering, cloud FortiAnalyzer for logs and basic FortiIdentity Cloud MFA. Endpoint protection (EPP): blocks malware, ransomware and exploits in real time based on behavior, checks suspicious files in a cloud sandbox and shields vulnerable software with virtual patching; shows which AI applications are installed and used. FortiGuard forensic analysis and monitoring by Fortinet’s SOC (SOCaaS) are included in the license. EDR: detects zero-day, fileless and living-off-the-land attacks by behavior, contains them automatically, rolls back changes and helps investigate; threat hunting. Full DLP: controls where sensitive data goes — to the web, cloud services, USB drives and GenAI tools. XDR and advanced DLP with insider risk management are in higher editions.
notIncluded: XDR and advanced DLP with insider risk management come with the higher editions.
classification: EDR and full DLP start with Plus.
Threat Hunting, XDR and DLP Advanced/Insider Risk stay in the text.
